Existing authoritative specification, CUI-only application authoring and all seven independent acceptance criteria remain mandatory.
Report screenshot source and actual launch/service composition; distinguish headless previews from native drawing/save/reopen and installed-app acceptance.
supersedes: Any worker interpretation that separate standalone launch wiring alone makes the current standalone apps obsolete.
authority: Direct owner clarification, 23 October 2026; complements earlier one-app-implementation requirement.
